verdict.rationale: Runpod's Pod docs say a deployed Pod can be reached through JupyterLab for data science or through VS Code/Cursor for local IDE integration, alongside SSH. Official PyTorch templates come with JupyterLab preconfigured and ready instantly. Community remarks about a locked-down environment concern Colab local runtimes and OpenZiti, not Jupyter or IDE access, so they don't contradict this. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that IDE connection is a single click or step (the VS Code/Cursor setup flow is not detailed), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Jupyter and IDE connection experience.
